connector.name: Putput MCP
connector.registryDescription: File uploads for AI agents. Upload, list, and manage files. No signup required.
connector.summary: Hosted at putput.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the putput-io-dev account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PUTPUT_TOKEN
env.description: PutPut API token. Get one free without signup: curl -X POST https://putput.io/api/v1/auth/guest | jq .token
